refuter_points_confirmed_against_scripts: test flags unfiltered (G:315-353; tcb-node only in profiles/coordinator.json:46)
new_finding: --interval-ms 0 is accepted (W:879-881), becomes the tick interval Δ (W:712), and makes every tick count toward hang (W:344-345). Result: false hang fences of every active child within seconds. Closed by the hook denying the test flags.

changes.FX-W1: Each alarm exclusively creates an exit marker (no lock) before it exits. The hook denies --now, --sleep-ms, --interval-ms and --free-mb.
changes.FX-W2: Confirmation counts slots that are live and have no exit marker; nonces carry no weight, so a reused nonce is harmless. One process query with a 10 s timeout; arm_confirm_ms is 45 s. A second reconcile keeps the turn armed.
changes.FX-W3: Armed = turn.json confirmed with the current ce AND no exit marker on its slots. The owner alert comes from the stuck count and unarmed_turns.
changes.FX-W4: Wake-to-run is required. The timing argument is corrected per H7. It alerts on no alarm, no process list, a stuck act, a busy run lock and unarmed turns, once per onset.
changes.FX-W5: Adds a stuck count after 3 re-raises at the capped interval.
changes.FX-W6: Idle becomes an act-due, never a charged hang. New attempt age cap (property BoundedAttempt).
changes.FX-W7: A busy run lock skips the tick (not counted, no write) and counts busy_ticks; the watcher exits only when it loses its own lock.
